title: Part Thirty-Three: The Pathway: Removing the Brakes

sections.brief: Five patterns that weakened veto points 2025-26 (removal: Slaughter/Cook, EO 14215, Schedule P/C; ~17 IGs 24 Jan 2025 and Storch; GAO's seven ICA findings, pocket rescission and the 26 Sep 2025 stay; IEEPA tariffs and Learning Resources; tax/Medicaid/TANF sharing and CFPB withdrawals), each with earlier use by both parties (Saul 2021, Walpin 2009, Biden RRB IG 2024, Ukraine hold 2019, wall pause 2021, Biden v. Nebraska, ORR 2018/2024/2025); If it were connected. Figures: compare, time

Input -> mechanism -> who gains -> who pays per pattern; the presidency as the documented gainer; CIGIE $71bn/$3.9bn; named programmes behind GAO findings; ~$166bn IEEPA duties refunded; Palantir as recipient of one Medicaid transfer, CDIA welcoming the data-broker withdrawal; overdraft CRA as a brake removed by Congress; no network authorship documented. Figures: money, stats

Held vs not held by courts (Learning Resources, CIT s.122, Cook, IRS-ICE, Medicaid, voter rolls, CFPB; Storch no remedy, pocket rescission, Slaughter, CASA, TANF, SAVE, Schedule P/C), Congress (Senate 50-46, House 219-211, AI moratorium 99-1), states; the road around the brake (s.122 -> s.301 on 60 economies); worst-case reading tested.
